nodes.label: Operations Dashboard Frontend
nodes.rationale: Plain HTML/CSS/ES modules served by the backend, no build step.

nodes.label: Driver Navigation Module (README)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first page separate from the operator dashboard; no build step or extra dependencies, reuses Leaflet and Socket.IO served by the backend.

nodes.label: 3D Intersection Digital Twin (Three.js)
nodes.rationale: A visualization, not a physics simulation; vehicles capped at 14 per approach and obey red/crosswalk/gap rules.

nodes.label: Overpass API Hazards (speed cameras, bumps)
nodes.rationale: Community-mapped OSM data is shown as not verified by SmartTraffic; road closures have no data source yet.

nodes.label: Nominatim Destination Search
nodes.rationale: Max 1 request/s policy, so no search-as-you-type; search runs on submit.

nodes.label: Traffic-Adjusted Routes Endpoint (planned)
nodes.rationale: Route labelled 'live AI-adjusted' only with numeric adjustedDuration, basis 'live-ai' and valid updatedAt; falls back to OSRM with 'Live traffic data unavailable'.

nodes.label: Historical Data (MongoDB)
nodes.rationale: Append-only dataset for later analysis and model training; DB is not required for signal control and retries every 15 s.

nodes.label: dataMode Stamping and modeFilter Rule
nodes.rationale: dataMode is set by the server (one history recorder per channel), never taken from requests; all queries must go through modeFilter so live and simulated history are exact complements.

nodes.label: Current Decision / Signal Heads / Emergency / System Panels
nodes.norm_label: current decision / signal heads / emergency / system panels

nodes.label: Data Source Mode Switch (Live traffic / Simulation)
nodes.norm_label: data source mode switch (live traffic / simulation)
nodes.rationale: Simulation = generated data, never shown as real traffic; SIMULATED DATA badge marks it.

nodes.label: Socket.IO Rooms (live / simulation)
nodes.rationale: Every client starts in the live room so clients unaware of simulation keep working; switching via 'subscribe' returns a fresh init.

nodes.label: Backend Test Suite
nodes.rationale: No test needs MongoDB; real database read/write is untested.

nodes.label: Navigation Reads Live Room Only
nodes.rationale: Page never subscribes to simulation and ignores any payload with dataMode 'simulation'.

nodes.label: smartTrafficNav.diagnostics()
nodes.rationale: Checks that live updates never duplicate the map or socket listeners.

nodes.label: Live AI Camera Panel
nodes.rationale: Placeholder until the Python/Flask camera service is connected; connectLiveVideo() mounts the stream.

nodes.label: Traffic Decision Engine
nodes.rationale: One state machine per intersection ticking every 250 ms; the browser never decides signal state; only one approach green at a time so straight-through movements never conflict.

nodes.label: POST /api/traffic Contract
nodes.rationale: Perception only sends one HTTP request per intersection per frame window (~1 Hz) and needs no knowledge of Socket.IO, Three.js, Leaflet or UI.

nodes.label: Simulation Mode
nodes.rationale: In-process simulator with its own decision engine and observation store so a failure only sets its state to error while live traffic keeps running.

nodes.label: Smart Traffic AI (project README)
nodes.rationale: Prototype adaptive traffic-signal management; explicitly not certified for real signals; DB integration and deployment not verified.

nodes.label: Missing Approach Geometry (traffic drawn as points)
nodes.norm_label: missing approach geometry (traffic drawn as points)
nodes.rationale: Without per-approach bearing or GeoJSON, routes cannot be matched to approaches nor roads coloured; coordinates are placeholders, route matching within 60 m.

nodes.label: Emergency Preemption and Hold
nodes.rationale: Confidence >= 0.80 preempts immediately even before minimum green; EMERGENCY_MAX_HOLD_TIME caps stuck detections; confirmed emergencies are not dropped on one weak frame.

nodes.label: Exclusive Pedestrian Phase
nodes.rationale: All vehicle approaches red during WALK then clearance; emergency shortens WALK but never skips clearance; cooldown prevents same people re-triggering.

nodes.label: Live/Simulation Data Isolation
nodes.rationale: The two channels share no state so simulated observations can never reach live state, live signal decisions or emergency preemption, and the live view never depends on the simulator.

nodes.label: PERCEPTION_HOLD_TIME Flicker Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Detections flicker frame to frame; pedestrian requests/emergencies are withdrawn only after absence for the hold time so one missed frame does not restart them.

nodes.label: Reserved Source Tags (mock/simulation -> HTTP 422)
nodes.rationale: Rejecting source 'mock'/'simulation' guarantees simulated data can never enter live state.
